overloads.semanticRole: Converts a numeric value between two 'Euroland' currencies (or the Euro itself), routing through the Euro when converting between two non-Euro national currencies.

constraints: Converting between two non-Euro national currencies is calculated via an intermediate conversion through the Euro, per European regulation.
Currency codes must be one of the predefined constants in the 'Euro Currencies' theme (e.g. "EUR", "FRF", "DEM", etc.).
